title: Take four pictures of the farmyard as seen from inside the house, one per way of drawing it, so Daniel can pick one
tier_reason: captures and a card edit; nothing players see yet
ask: This card cannot be done by the unattended build queue: the captures need a display and the timer runs without one (hq/data/staff/claude/memory.md, 2026-09-04). Do not attempt the captures headless. What a worker without a display does instead: write the capture tool only — tools/capture_through_walls.tscn/.gd modelled on tools/capture_window_view.gd (read that file first; it is short) — that takes a treatment name from the command line (`--treatment=none|haze|desaturate|hardcut`), loads the same farm and hour each run, walks the player into the house, applies the treatment as a shader or dither on the yard layer, and saves docs/design/mockups/through_walls/<treatment>.png to scratch. Do not run it. Then set the card's next step to: `godot --path . res://tools/capture_through_walls.tscn --treatment=<each>` by hand in a session with a display, and attach the four files to hq/data/decisions/Q-108.json.
first_action: Read tools/capture_window_view.gd and CLAUDE.md's capture-tool entries, then write the tool without running it.
source_message: Daniel said yes to the arrival rule (S-16) and the spawn rule (S-17) on 2026-09-20; docs/QUEUE_TO_ZERO.md §12 is the build order.

amendments.what: brief rewritten after the card was parked for cost
amendments.why: Three attempts tried to shoot captures under a timer that has no display.
